__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You will become him if you are not careful.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A poor mudder, lost in this place.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle poor mudder

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You can't tell what the star looks like, she is too bright!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A beautiful white star smiles at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle star

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It hasn't got a definite shape, it is just a cloud of mist.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A young nebula, waiting to become a star.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle nebula young

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see the offspring of Halley's comet, here just to wipe everything out.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A speedy comet is waiting to crush your head in.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle comet speedy

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You notice the giant is not as tough as his name sounds ...
Still he can be very powerful.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An enormous, red supergiant is forced to protect the galaxy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle red supergiant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Like the red giant, he is also appointed to stand guard for the galaxy.
But somehow he manages to escape.  Though tiny, it can take a lot of hits!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A tiny white dwarf is trying to sneak away from duty.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle white dwarf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You can only make out its shape from the darkness.  He was cursed to stay in
here and his face may never be seen by anyone again.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A huge nebula is here, resembling a horsehead.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle horsehead nebula

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She was once a princess of beauty.  However, her beauty has led to a Goddess's
jealousy and she has to suffer here endlessly until Perseus comes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The poor Andromeda is chained to the wall, suffering ...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle andromeda

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He has been put to do the Ten Labours -- ten impossible tasks, by Hera, the
queen goddess, who disliked him.  But he finished them all and at the end was
granted immortality. He is a very brave and strong fighter.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Mighty Hercules is working hard on his extra Labours for the Gods.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hercules

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It is the legendary horse with wings on its back.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The wild pegasus is grazing peacefully.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pegasus

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is the legendary hunter who almost defeated Taurus the bull, but got
killed by Scorpio.  The gods put them both up as constellations but one
appears on one side of the sky and the other the other side so they will
never meet.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Orion is still hunting for Scorpio.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle orion

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
These are the seven sisters of the Myths, and as for why they are here, no
one knows; even the Gods themselves have forgotten.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Pleiades are here, weeping for the loss of their sisters.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pleiades

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This evil-looking head is even larger than a giant.  He is the last guardian
before entering the inner galaxy.  His neck is flexing in a random fashion so
hitting the head is certainly not easy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The gigantic Head of Draco lurks out from beneath and prepares to roast you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle draco head

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a tiny creature which looks like a dragon except that its body
resembles a snake.  Gosh, is this a draco, you wonder, is this the thing
we are on now?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A baby draco is crawling on the Draco's body.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle draco baby

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a white goat here, the first guardian of the Zodiac,
also the ruler of Spring. He looks as if he is expecting you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Aries is sitting here, welcoming you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle aries

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a wild-looking bull with a bad temper.  He is well-built and looks like
he can fight well ... indeed he has fought with Orion before and survived.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Taurus wants to leave, but has been forced to stay as a guardian here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle taurus

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
As soon as you see him you know that he is the most perfect man you have seen.
You can't find any imperfections on him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Gemini is looking for his brother; have you seen him?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gemini

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
As soon as you see him you see the most imperfect man you have ever seen.
How can there be such a contrast?  You wonder ...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Gemini is hiding from his brother, grinning evilly at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle gemini

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a gigantic crab (YES, it is bigger than you!) with a crushed shell.
Legend is that he was crushed by Hercules when he was sent by Hera to kill him.
So Hera made Cancer a constellation for his work.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Cancer the crab is here, hoarding the treasure away from you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cancer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
His metallic skin means that he could be the one which was killed by Hercules
during his first Labour.  His skin is so weapon-proof that Hercules had to use
his bare hands to tear the lion into two from its mouth!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Leo the lion is roaring at you, ready for a strike!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle leo

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
From what you have seen, you now realize that legends are legends, and Virgo
may not be the maid of chastity and purity at all!  But still she looks
gorgeous and is waiting for your first move, whatever it is ...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Virgo is sitting here, winking at you suggestively ... you are alarmed!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle virgo

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is a wise old man and can see people's thoughts through their eyes....
Now all he can see from you is greed and bloodshed.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Libra, the fair and just, is staring at you, weighing up the sins of your past.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle libra

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Ever since he killed Orion in the myths, he has been punished by having
Sagittarius' arrow aimed at his heart forever.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Scorpio is moving his tail towards you, waiting to put an end to some mortals.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle scorpio

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He is a centaur and a well trained archer. No one can escape his arrows.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Sagittarius the centaur is waiting to let go of his well aimed arrow ...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sagittarius

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a mean-looking ram here.  He used to be a fierce fighter in the ancient
war but now the gods have decided to put him here, to live out the rest of his
days in peace.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Capricorn is here, feeling bored ... he wants a fight!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle capricorn

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The pretty Water Bearer is smiling at you, you think you'd better give her a
hand with holding the vessel.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The beautiful Aquarius is standing here, holding THE vessel.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle aquarius

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She has been forced to serve her husband, who had been cursed to turn into a
fish and she deserves your pity.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Pisces the mermaid is sitting here, waiting for your help.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pisces mermaid

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He was once a very handsome man but now has turned into an ugly big fish.
So he becomes jealous of any living thing which is more handsome than him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Pisces the fish, is jealous of your approach...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pisces fish

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The Huge Bear which resides in the northern skies is here.
You think you'd better turn back.  At least you have got a chance of survival.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Ursa Major the bear is the last defense against any intruders.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bear ursa major

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: She is the Queen of Dignity; facing her you feel all your dignity has gone.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Cassiopeia, the queen of the Universe, is sitting on her throne.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cassiopeia queen

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is the King of Might as well as of the Universe. You suddenly feel very
weak and useless in front of him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Cepheus, the king of the Universe, is sitting on his throne.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cepheus king

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is the Master of the Universe, (NOT He-Man!), the most powerful!
Even the King and the Queen obey him.  As you look at him you notice he is
actually a STAR, with dazzling bright light ... maybe you shouldn't have come
here at all?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Polaris, the polar star, who commands the whole Universe, stands before you!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle polaris polar star
